verdict.rationale: Extend documents webhook subscriptions to global and workflow-specific events, configurable in the dashboard or via API, which can drive downstream automation. It also offers deployable workflows and confidence scores that can auto-accept high-confidence values and route the rest to human review. However, there is no evidence of a native rules engine where users define event→action triggers inside the product; automation relies mainly on outbound webhooks plus user-built handlers. Missing for 10: a first-party event-triggered rule/automation builder, documentation of conditional actions beyond confidence-based review routing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
